warnings.why: A yield of 27,700 kg/ha for cereal is biologically and agronomically implausible for a desert country without massive greenhouse operations that would not be standard field cereal agriculture.
A yield of 22,500 kg/ha exceeds world records for open-field cereal yields, making it extremely suspect for a hyper-arid climate.
A yield of 15,000 kg/ha is exceptionally high and likely reflects greenhouse production, hydroponics, or a unit reporting error rather than standard cereal field yield.
A yield of 14,200 kg/ha is unrealistic for traditional cereal farming in an arid environment with scarce arable land and water.

policy: model memory is advisory; unsupported suspicions cannot overrule official data
